simple.meaning: זֶרֶת (zereth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:16. The surrounding context includes altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זֶרֶת (H2239) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: זֶרֶת (zereth) / H2239 is traced through Exodus 28:16, Exodus 39:9, 1 Samuel 17:4, Isaiah 40:12 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span

firstOccurrence.englishText: It shall be square and folded double; a span* A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.) shall be its length, and a span its width.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.) Therefore, Goliath was about 9 feet and 9 inches or 2.97 meters tall. went out.

definitions.short: the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span
definitions.full: H2239. zereth זֶ֫רֶת noun feminine span (Late Hebrew id. ( זַרְתָּא ᵑ7 , Syriac ; apparently from Hebrew), etymology dubious; Thes and most derive from √ זרה , see Ol § 146 b but also Sta § 187 a ; Ba ZMG 1887, 607 proposes √ זרה measure off, determine , compare p. 280) — span , as standard of measurement, בַּז ׳שָׁמַיִם תִּכֵּן Isa 40:12 ; elsewhere of actual size, a span , distance between ends of thumb and little finger of spread hand; = 1/2 cubit (see אַמָּה & references; compare Exod 25:10 with Joseph Ant. iii. 6 , 5), ׳ז 28:16 (twice in verse); 39:9 (twice in verse) (all P) Ezek 43:13 ; זָ֑רֶת 1Sam 17:4 six cubits and a span. See Hultsch Metrol. 1882, 443 Benz Archäol. 179 .
